summary: BioStudies supplied Greenwood et al.'s published salt-loading results in Table S1. All 3,564 matched complete-probe gene effects agree in direction, covering 62.32% of the identifiable selected reference. That coverage is below the author-concordance-v2 minimum.

manualReview.summary: Selected salt-loading effects compared against the published Table S1
manualReview.note: Greenwood et al., Table S1. The 9,843 salt-versus-euhydrated probe sets all have reported BH-adjusted P < 0.05. S1 omits probes outside this selected list. GSE65663, male Sprague-Dawley rat bulk supraoptic nucleus. The ten GSMs match the registered sample sheet by accession and source title. Each of the five arrays per group measures an independent RNA pool of five rats. Individual pool membership is unavailable. Seven days of 2% saline in place of drinking water minus euhydrated control. The S1 group means and signed Log FC confirm SL minus EU. Water deprivation is a separate GSE3110 experiment. Among 3,564 matched genes, 3,079 use the published single-probe log2 effect and 485 use the equal-weight mean of all constituent S1 log2 effects. Averaging group differences matches the registered pre-fit log-scale probe average. All 3,564 have the same nonzero sign. Pearson r and Spearman rho both round to 1.000000. The median absolute log2 difference is 3.39e-08. The pairs cover 3,564/5,719 (62.32%) of the selected single-Entrez reference and 3,564/14,604 (24.40%) of registered genes. The selected reference falls below the 90% v2 coverage requirement. GeneSpring used unmoderated Welch tests with BH correction per probe. The registered limma analysis uses moderated gene tests after probe aggregation. Both raw and adjusted P are present on all S1 rows. Among 3,079 comparable single-probe tests, 3,079 author and 2,997 registered results pass BH < 0.05. For the 485 multi-probe effect pairs, S1 supplies no combined gene P or FDR. The primary comparison, extraction and complementary Johnson et al. analysis are retained in data/author-validation/continued-sources/GSE65663/codex-2026-11-21.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Use the published SL-minus-EU orientation, all selected S1 probe rows, and identical probe membership for the primary gene-effect join. Keep unpaired named reference genes in the denominator. Author-concordance-v2 requires at least 30 pairs and 90% relevant coverage, plus Pearson and Spearman at least 0.90 or at least 90% same-sign effects across at least 30 nonzero pairs covering 90% of pairs. Evaluate BH and raw P separately.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Both effect-agreement routes pass on the paired genes. Selected-reference coverage fails the shared 90% requirement. Full verification remains open.
